candidates.sentence: With 220,000 Medicare beneficiaries in Florida’s 16th District, Buchanan is committed to preserving Medicare’s long-term solvency for senior citizens, as well as bringing down the cost of health care for all Americans.
He will continue to be a strong advocate for protecting and strengthening Medicare for both today’s seniors and future generations.
Buchanan previously served as chairman of the Tax Policy Subcommittee and played a key role in passage of a sweeping tax cut bill.
He has worked to enact tax incentives to help small businesses, end burdensome regulations and limit frivolous lawsuits.
Buchanan was awarded the “Champion for Healthy Seniors” award by a leading advocacy group for protecting Medicare and fighting for lower prescription drug costs.
